messages.subject: Colour in geom_line and geom_point
parts:
What stupid thing am I doing here ? Or has the syntax changed and I missed it?

I get a red line and blue points when I thought I was asking for a blue line and red points?

library(ggplot2)
dat1  <-  data.frame(xx = 1:10,
                     yy = rnorm(10))
ggplot(dat1, aes(xx, yy)) + geom_line(aes(colour = "blue")) +
                            geom_point(aes(colour = "red")) +
                            theme(legend.position="none")

messages.author: 9c9b5f9c6aaa025d
messages.subject: Re: Colour in geom_line and geom_point
parts: When you put the colors inside `aes` you are *mapping* the colors, not *setting* the colors. You can read more about this in Hadley's ggplot2 book (and I am sure elsewhere on the web). You want: geom_line(colour = "blue") + geom_point(colour = "red")
